title: Corebridge Financial, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Corebridge Financial, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 16, 2026, disclosing preliminary Q1 2026 variable investment income estimated at $15-25 million (pre-tax), citing positive alternative investment returns offset by unrealized mark-to-market losses.
